policy: No external source code/prose copied. Core code uses NumPy/local numerical primitives, never external clustering estimators.
alignments: Explicit Lloyd centers; Euclidean linkage heights with tie-aware checks; DBSCAN self-inclusive neighborhoods; HDBSCAN self-inclusive support/exact dense MST/EOM/root exclusion; flat Mean Shift; aligned full-covariance EM initialization; spectral eigenspace/partition invariants.
limitations: DIANA uses full independent splinter-trace oracles rather than a different algorithm as a reference. Spectral row normalization and HDBSCAN lambda scaling conventions are explicit.
